Lemma
[Expansion for $\partial _\tau r_\tau $] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0301 ↗ lem:chow-iii-changing-distance-bound 1. ch24:24.22\group Heat Kernel Asymptotics

In $g(\tau )$-normal coordinates $x_\tau ^i$ centered at $y$, \[ \partial _\tau r_\tau (x)=\frac{\mathcal R_{ij}x_\tau ^ix_\tau ^j}{r_\tau } +\frac{(\nabla _k\mathcal R_{ij})x_\tau ^kx_\tau ^ix_\tau ^j}{2r_\tau } +O(r_\tau ^3), \] with tensors evaluated at $(y,\tau )$.
